scope: Opt-in summon control (ModSettings.ControlSummons, off by default): in combat, both modes, AI Control drives linked summons of the characters it drives through the existing tactical engine, drivers and dispatcher. Turn-based entry on the game's own AI turn (TurnController.Prepare postfix, TickBrain prefix, Tick postfix); no status, controllability, faction or group write. Not pets, swarms, nested, unlinked or enemy summons; not with the old real-time engine. A summon uses its own abilities, its summoner's blocklist, friendly-fire rule, heal threshold and spell policy; no summoning spell, item or material component. With the switch off nothing changes except that a summon another mod makes clickable is no longer driven like a companion.
